overclaims: Meta similarly redirected its strategy toward superintelligence described as in sight.
checks.note: Statement excerpt and proposition are faithful, and the outcome matches the reviews. Three citation excerpts are cut to fragments of the frozen exact words. e5 'progress slows' turns the UK's conditional 'Even if AI progress slows' into what reads as a flat statement, which is misleading. e2 'AGI and ASI' and e4 'training and inference' drop the content that matters, such as 'already started' workloads. 'Redirected' claims Meta changed course, but e3 only shows Meta directing its efforts toward superintelligence; no earlier strategy is shown.
